product: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes
tagline: Chat sharing (GA): Sharing an individual Genie Agent conversation is now generally available.
what_it_does: Chat sharing (GA): Sharing an individual Genie Agent conversation is now generally available. Download visualizations on Private Link (Beta): You can now download visualization results through the Genie Conversation API on Private Link workspaces in supported regions. File upload fix: Fixed a bug where the option to upload CSV and Excel files to a Genie Agent from Genie One was removed.
